question: Can the current TECT owner evaluate the fixed F_total[G_*]-F_total[E] sign, full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability under the unchanged common finite-regulator contract?
exact_scope: A fresh TECT-owner execution snapshot. The same fifteen finite-regulator fields and the G_* minus E orientation are locked to the prior R-434/R-427/R-420 contract without alteration; E is preregistered as a slot but remains subject to admission. The lane evaluates no energy, derivative or Hessian when a common owner is absent.

owner_contract.candidate: native Reading-H Gaussian-Hartree covariance owner G_*

normalization.owner: G_* convention only; E normalization absent

empty_branch_E_representation.owner: no normalized state, measure, algebra or preparation

physical_empty_branch_E.declared_role: normalized constrained, no-condensate or empty-preparation branch in the same parent as G_*
physical_empty_branch_E.reason: No owner supplies a normalized E in the same finite parent as G_*; the P1 zero/disordered reference remains a separate owner and cannot be aliased.

reading_h_stationarity.expression: D F_total[G_*] = 0 on the full admissible regulated tangent

symmetry_projected_transverse_stability.expression: inf_{v in N_perp, ||v||=1} <v, D^2 F_total[G_*] v>

authority_inputs.role: same-owner revalidation contract and blocked verdict baseline
Reading-H applicability firewall; no physical-empty sign
future same-parent empty-branch contract, not an admitted state

assumptions: The six hash-pinned authorities above are the active TECT-owner boundaries.
The requested orientation is G_* minus E and all three tests must share one regulated parent.
The fifteen contract fields are identity-locked; a locked field name does not invent an owner value.
A physical-empty branch requires a normalized representative, measure or algebra, boundary preparation and a local physical criterion beyond a zero label.
Input-admissibility failure is a valid bounded-test outcome and is not a numerical sign or stability theorem.
Symmetry projection requires the exact orbit tangent and a regulated Hessian error budget.
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned finite-regulator F_total with a common domain containing G_* and E.
A normalized, admitted E representative with measure/algebra, boundary preparation and a no-condensate or clustering criterion.
Common reference, normalization, finite-part counterterms and renormalization conditions.
Fixed regulator/cutoff, physical volume, boundary condition and explicit limit order.
Deterministic finite-parent maps for G_* and E, a full admissible tangent and exact symmetry orbit tangent.
A transverse projector, regulated Hessian, stationarity residual budget and numerical/limit error budgets.
blockers: R-169 and R-170 provide owner-specific covariance/applicability boundaries, not one common Reading-H F_total with an E comparison.
R-427 and R-420 identity-lock the fifteen fields but leave their values unsupplied and E uninstantiated.
R-418 forbids replacing E by zero or the P1 reference; EXP-000790 is a future contract only.
Therefore sign, full stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability are undefined for this owner and cannot be evaluated.
evidence_level: T0 / EXECUTED APPEND-ONLY TECT-OWNER INPUT-ADMISSIBILITY AUDIT; all three physical quantities BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED
non_claims: No identification of E with zero, P1, a Gaussian state or an equilibrium phase.
No physical-vacuum, below-empty-space, Yang-Mills, mass-gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A conclusion.
No thermodynamic, continuum, OS/KMS/GNS, Hamiltonian spectral or absolute-energy conclusion.

formal_integration.event_title: R-441 physical-empty bounded test owner execution
formal_integration.lean: R441 PASS; unchanged blocked input-admissibility scope only

adversarial_review.check: Any attempt to identify E with zero or P1 is rejected because no same-owner normalized branch is supplied.
G_* covariance data and a separate P1 or other finite parent cannot be combined into one F_total domain.
Dropping or changing any of the fifteen locked fields invalidates this execution.
An unspecified counterterm or scalar shift cannot instantiate the missing state-dependent E comparison.
Covariance-owner stationarity cannot be promoted to full-field stationarity on an absent tangent.
No Hessian infimum is formed without a common orbit tangent, projector and error budget.
A blocked owner audit is not promoted to a physical, Yang-Mills or mass-gap statement.

boundary: R-441 executes the unchanged fifteen-field TECT-owner contract and preregisters E. Because the common finite parent and admitted E are still absent, all three requested quantities remain BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED.
next_unlock: Provide one owner-approved hash-pinned finite parent containing both G_* and a normalized admitted E, then rerun the unchanged three tests with the full tangent, orbit projector and error budgets frozen.
